title: Developer check: a failed save or a change made mid-save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its card shows one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Make the save of a Sales Representative change fail (for example by going offline in the browser) and pick {Sales-rep-A}.
  2. With the connection back, pick {Sales-rep-B} and, before it finishes saving, pick {Sales-rep-A} and click the + button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the field returns to the last saved value and an error message shows.
  • Step 2: the change made while the first was saving is ignored and the + cannot be clicked until the save finishes; then the field shows what was saved ({Sales-rep-B}).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-N3, S1-E1, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N3: “If a change cannot be saved, the field returns to the last saved value and an error message shows.”
  • S1-E1: “A change made while the previous change is still saving is ignored, and the + and remove x cannot be clicked until the save finishes. When it finishes, the field shows what was saved.”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a forced save failure and a timed second click; check with developer tools or automation, not by hand
